name: packaging
description: Build and maintain agent skill marketplace repos: scaffold a new one, rename it to convention, audit its layout, and refactor it into shape.

interface.shortDescription: Create, rename, audit, and refactor agent skill marketplace repos
interface.longDescription: Packaging bundles the four skills used to build and maintain skill marketplace repos: plugin-create scaffolds a new repo end to end, rename-repo moves an existing one onto the naming convention and fixes every hardcoded reference, structure-check audits a repo's layout read-only, and structure-refactor applies the fixes.
defaultPrompt: Package these skills into a new plugin marketplace repo.
